name: Olive
personality: Slow talker who never forgets to say thank you.

lines.text: Hello... dear. It's Olive. Take your time. I always do.
I would like... the [dish]. Please. ...Thank you.
Just the [dish], if it's no trouble. No hurry. Truly.
Is that a new restaurant name I keep hearing? [restaurant]... how lovely.

choices.text: Thank you! We picked it ourselves.
